candidates.excerpt: Construction of the 6.2-km Uppal-Narapally elevated corridor in Hyderabad has slowed significantly despite the completion of its concrete piers, with girder installation yet to begin. Daily commuters and local traders are facing severe traffic congestion, dust and poor road conditions.
